abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.text:
Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.

Passive: Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.

abilities.name: Light of Elune
abilities.text:
Heal an ally Hero for 270. Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero.

Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.text: Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120 damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunar Flare
abilities.text:
After 0.75 seconds, deal 150 damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit.

Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 3%, up to 120%. Double this bonus if the Hero dies within 3 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Every 8th Basic Attacks fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes. Attack Range increased by 1.

abilities.name: Shadowstalk
abilities.text: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.text: Deal 92 damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

1.name: Ranger
1.text: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

1.name: Moonlit Arrows
1.text: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Trueshot Aura
1.text: Activate to grant Tyrande and nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.

4.name: Everlasting Light
4.text: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

4.name: Mark of Mending
4.text: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

4.name: Elune's Chosen
4.text: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

7.name: Elune's Gift
7.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Lunar Flare grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

7.name: Kaldorei Resistance
7.text: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

7.name: Huntress' Fury
7.text:
Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.

Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

10.name: Shadowstalk
10.text: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

10.name: Starfall
10.text: Deal 92 damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

13.name: Quickening Blessing
13.text: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Harsh Moonlight
13.text: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Ranger's Mark
13.text: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

16.name: Celestial Attunement
16.text: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

16.name: Empower
16.text: Reduce Sentinel's cooldown by 3 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel takes bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Darnassian Archery
16.text: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant a stacking 12% increased Attack Damage bonus for 4 seconds.

20.name: Eyes of the Huntress
20.text: Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 100% more.

20.name: Celestial Wrath
20.text: Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.

20.name: Iceblade Arrows
20.text: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
